# 从颜色标签到自旋操作：三条推导路线: # From color labels to spin operations: three derivation routes
这三个可选工坊位于“自旋与扩展对称”课堂的色群、自旋稳定子与 SOC 锁定课中。: These optional workshops accompany the color-group, spin-only stabilizer and SOC-locking lessons in Spin and Extended Symmetries. Predict first and calculate manually; after inspecting the steps, change one condition to test your explanation.
二色标签的交换可形式化为线性矩阵 P=σx。电子自旋 1/2 的时间反演在本站约: A two-color label exchange can be extended formally to the linear matrix P=σx. For electron spin one-half, this site uses time reversal Θ=−iσyK, with K conjugating the complex amplitudes first. These are explicitly different action spaces; using two components does not make them the same physical object.
分别比较 Pψ、ψ*、Θψ 和两次作用；再输入复标量 c，比较 P(cψ)=cP: Compare Pψ, ψ*, Θψ and two successive applications. Then choose a complex scalar c and compare P(cψ)=cPψ with Θ(cψ)=c*Θψ. A real c can conceal the difference. After changing the operator phase, compute the antiunitary square AA*, rather than substituting the ordinary matrix square A².
相同分量、相同射线和正交是不同判断。工坊同时给出 ⟨Pψ|Θψ⟩ 与 ⟨ψ|Θψ: Equal components, the same ray and orthogonality are different tests. The workshop provides both ⟨Pψ|Θψ⟩ and ⟨ψ|Θψ⟩. The exact counterexample H=σx preserves P but has two nondegenerate levels; it does not preserve Θ. Kramers pairing also requires the relevant antiunitary symmetry of the Hamiltonian. A same-momentum claim in a crystal additionally requires checking momentum.
原三色图案实验是另一个几何对照。复制按钮会完整初始化该实验的受支持参数，等待手动: The original three-color pattern experiment is a separate geometric comparison. Copying initializes its complete supported inputs and waits for a manual run; a two-component complex state is not treated as three colors.
把有序磁矩排成 M=[m₁ … mN]，用精确秩确定它们张成的空间。纯自旋操作的: Arrange the ordered moments as M=[m₁ … mN] and determine their span using exact rank. A spin-only operation has identity spatial action: every moment must satisfy Wmᵢ=mᵢ at its original site. Preserving a pattern after permuting different sites does not meet this pointwise condition.
若磁矩张成空间的秩为 r，其完整经典稳定子同构于 O(3−r)。工坊展示张成空间: For a moment span of rank r, the full classical stabilizer is isomorphic to O(3−r). The workshop displays the span, its orthogonal complement, the projector and pointwise residuals for the selected W. Zero, collinear, coplanar and three-dimensional spans give O(3), O(2), the two-element plane-reflection group and the identity group, respectively. The unitary proper-rotation part is listed separately.
det W=−1 时，先取 V=−W∈SO(3)，再用 D(V)Θ 实现经典作用: When det W=−1, take V=−W∈SO(3) and implement the classical action through D(V)Θ. The interface separately shows W², the spin-factor matrix and its antiunitary square: classical W²=I does not determine the sign of the spinor square. This spin factor excludes spatial-orbital and Bloch-phase actions and cannot alone diagnose band degeneracy.
这是对精确输入图案的稳定子计算，不按测量容差识别近共面性，也不搜索完整自旋空间群: This stabilizer calculation applies to the exactly specified input pattern. It does not classify near-coplanarity using measurement tolerances, search a full spin space group or verify a material Hamiltonian.
## 独立自旋操作与 SOC 锁定: ## Independent spin actions and SOC locking
在相同的有序结构上，先检验给定的独立组合 [U∥R|t]。随后分别构造普通幺正分: First test the supplied independent combination [U∥R|t] on the same ordered structure. Then construct the ordinary unitary branch W=det(R)R and the branch with time reversal, W=−det(R)R, separately. Check positions, chemical labels and moments site by site.
“候选 W 等于给定 U”与“候选 W 保持此图案”分别显示。前者检查原操作是否: The statements “candidate W equals the supplied U” and “candidate W preserves this pattern” are displayed separately. The first tests whether the original operation obeys the locking rule; the second checks pattern matching for a candidate operation. Failure of one ordinary unitary branch does not exclude a magnetic operation with time reversal. Neither test proves symmetry of a real SOC Hamiltonian.
周期模型允许位置相差整数晶格平移；有限点图案不作周期折回。自定义周期输入使用单位: Periodic models permit positions differing by integer lattice translations; finite point patterns are not periodically wrapped. Custom periodic inputs use a unit orthogonal lattice, whose spatial rotations must preserve the integer translation lattice. Unwrapped positions and target sites are retained together, so the finite displayed fragment is not mistaken for a complete space group.
自定义数值仅接受有界有限十进制数与有理数 p/q，不执行表达式。非零复态与算符相: Custom numbers accept bounded finite decimals and rational p/q values; expressions are not executed. Nonzero complex states and operator phases are normalized exactly. Custom orthogonal matrices must pass an exact check, which rounded rotation matrices may fail. At most 12 ordered sites or moments are accepted.
精确字符串由 Python 有理数与代数矩阵计算产生，数值镜像用于三维显示。局部: Exact strings are generated by rational and algebraic matrix calculations in Python; numerical mirrors support the three-dimensional display. Panel results can be exported separately. Copying to an original geometric experiment passes only its supported inputs and keeps the scope of the two calculations distinct.
